title: Ascended Gear SMP
description: The modpack used on the Ascended Gear SMP. Mainly focused on the Create and Aether mods, with some other content as filler.
body: This modpack is used for the Ascended Gear SMP, a private server for me and my friends, though all modrinth users can use this as a fun tech and adventure themed pack to play on. This pack is mainly focused on the Create and Aether mods, though has some other content mods such as exposure, monobank, farmers delight, and spear backport. Have fun!
